g.title: login
g.text: LDAP bind OR retained fixed demo accounts
Database employee must exist and be active
Role is read from employees, not the form

g.title: user
g.text: Own bills, progress and PDA balance

g.title: manager
g.text: Open, allocate, top up, close accounts

g.title: submit
g.text: Reserve free funds once; log submission

g.title: rejected
g.text: Refile as a new bill if needed

g.title: views
g.text: QR + print: no public data access

g.title: mail
g.text: Failure does not undo the decision
